text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen, where competitors are 
chosen by fan votes. Satono Diamond placed 
2nd in the fan voting, with Kitasan Black 
taking 1st.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The crowd erupts as the two make their 
entrance. Not to be outdone, Satono 
Diamond's own fighting spirit boiled just 
as hot.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her goal of becoming a "renowned 
Umamusume." Being able to race Kitasan 
Black along the way brings Satono Diamond 
supreme joy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'll catch up to Kitasan Black—the one 
I've been chasing all this time—in this 
Arima Kinen—!
